description: Master ABL production registry. Owners identify operating roles.

projects.title: Play and save the league
projects.purpose: Advance the ABL in OOTP at the commissioner's chosen pace and capture the saved league date.
projects.next_action: Choose the next game, day or series in OOTP. Save before starting a checkpoint.

projects.title: Season calendar and playing windows
projects.purpose: Use league 200 dates and game state to distinguish verified finals from upcoming fixtures.
projects.next_action: Choose the playing window and record it at session close.

projects.title: September call-ups
projects.purpose: Capture a pre-expansion roster baseline and verify actual moves, player roles and affiliate context.
projects.next_action: At OOTP's expansion event, export both roster states and reconcile call-ups before coverage.

projects.title: Postseason qualification and coverage
projects.purpose: Prepare DCS, CCS and Grand Series coverage using three division winners and one wild card per conference.
projects.next_action: Validate the field against OOTP and apply same-division DCS protection before any bracket is used.

projects.title: Season close and rollover
projects.purpose: Freeze regular-season and postseason evidence, final reports and protection receipts before rollover.
projects.next_action: Use the season-end checkpoint at the Grand Series final and before confirming OOTP rollover.

projects.title: OOTP export and verification
projects.purpose: Stage the 72 registered game exports and reconcile results, logs, player totals and as-of date.
projects.next_action: Export from the saved league and validate the intended cutoff before preparing coverage.

projects.title: League intelligence and continuity
projects.purpose: Refresh the ABL 411, results memo, standings movement and club story continuity from verified games.
projects.next_action: Read the latest desk sheet after each completed export.

projects.title: Story candidates and claim evidence
projects.purpose: Surface traceable candidates and preserve correction and continuity evidence for story selection.
projects.next_action: Review the slate and chase a claim only when its evidence answers the reporting question.

projects.title: StatsPlus and sortable enrichment
projects.purpose: Use modeled odds, ELO and other enrichment with explicit as-of and authority labels.
projects.next_action: Profile a fresh batch before using model fields for August or later coverage.

projects.title: Story selection and corrections
projects.purpose: Select leads, review source claims and create a dated revision when approved copy changes.
projects.next_action: Review the next slate and file a linked revision for any approved correction.

projects.title: Daily Newsroom export poll
projects.purpose: Watch the OOTP export fingerprint and prepare a local desk edition when the source changes.
projects.next_action: Check the last receipt for failures or stale inputs before relying on the edition.

projects.title: Division wire and ballpark coverage
projects.purpose: Track movement, direct matchups and follow-up questions across all six divisions.
projects.next_action: Update each division after its relevant series and select stories for review.

projects.title: Baseball Observer
projects.purpose: Develop the leading evidence-backed narrative and identify the next game that can resolve it.
projects.next_action: Choose an angle for the next Observer issue and review the evidence packet.

projects.title: ABL 411
projects.purpose: Brief the commissioner on results, division movement and upcoming schedule.
projects.next_action: Use the current 411 as the post-day and pregame briefing.

projects.title: Ballpark Feed and featured games
projects.purpose: Package a game intro, game footage and a recap around verified matchup stakes.
projects.next_action: Choose a featured game and prepare its intro before first pitch.

projects.title: It's Monday weekly program
projects.purpose: Compare the past reporting week with the current division races and select a weekly segment mix.
projects.owner: Ernie Bewell desk and SBV producer
projects.next_action: At the first Monday desk, run the weekly packet for the last completed reporting window.

projects.title: Deep Dive 25 and flashback programming
projects.purpose: Prepare season retrospectives and contrast current stories with supported historical context.
projects.next_action: Select a season and test its archival claims before scripting.

projects.title: Production Control menu
projects.purpose: Launch the dashboard and session controller through the established PowerShell menu.
projects.next_action: Open the Command Center from Production Control at the start of play.

projects.title: League safety backup
projects.purpose: Keep a rolling safety copy of the saved game and record the verified data files for the session.
projects.next_action: Connect H: and run the protected checkpoint before starting optional production.

projects.title: ABL Input Data and repository update
projects.purpose: Use the existing exact-set Preview and checksum-verified Update for the repository CSV mirror.
projects.next_action: Preview differences, then approve Update when ready to refresh inputs.

projects.title: Star schema and analytic reports
projects.purpose: Build compatible fact tables and analytic reports for stats, comparison and EB research.
projects.next_action: Run the selected build against a verified cutoff and retain its output receipt.

projects.title: OOTP HTML report generation
projects.purpose: Generate and inspect the OOTP HTML report tree for the chosen saved state.
projects.next_action: Generate reports in OOTP when a website update or a historical freeze is needed.

projects.title: OBS recordings and footage
projects.purpose: Record selected games and retain original MKV footage before cutting a program.
projects.next_action: Close the recording and play a short sample before backing up.

projects.title: Voiceover, edit and production masters
projects.purpose: Assemble approved narration and visuals and render a production master.
projects.next_action: Verify the rendered master before queuing the exact file for approval.

projects.title: Video originals and masters backup
projects.purpose: Preserve top-level OBS MKVs and finished MP4s on H: using the existing two copy lanes.
projects.next_action: Preview both lanes and explicitly run Update after the media stop changing.

projects.title: H: to I: mirror and verification
projects.purpose: Use read-only verification to inspect replica drift and separately authorize any mirror deletions.
projects.next_action: Verify on both mounted volumes and inspect extras, failures and exclusions before deciding on a mirror update.

projects.title: HTML website update
projects.purpose: Release an approved HTML report bundle to the established site and retain its receipt.
projects.next_action: Verify the site destination and upload procedure with the commissioner before the first tracked update.

projects.title: StatsPlus league update
projects.purpose: Track the external StatsPlus league refresh independently from OOTP CSV sync and local enrichment.
projects.next_action: Confirm the active StatsPlus upload process and record approval and the resulting link separately.

projects.title: Editorial, forum and video releases
projects.purpose: Keep the reviewed artifact hash, channel, approval and final public URL together.
projects.next_action: Queue the selected exact artifact, obtain approval, and record its URL after manual publication.

projects.title: Session checkpoint archive
projects.purpose: Retain protected-session receipts, source fingerprints, run logs, deferred work and publication decisions.
dependencies: Verified league backup and session record
projects.next_action: Close each played session and retain the recorded checkpoint and any pending work.

projects.title: Historical reconstruction and almanac
projects.purpose: Preserve source HTML and derived season packs for 1972 through 1980 with source-level validation.
projects.next_action: Rebuild or extend a historical season only when inputs and intended coverage are clear.

projects.title: Data governance and historical source pack
projects.purpose: Retain source precedence, cutoff compatibility and the July project history behind current work.
projects.next_action: Use the newest verified August edition for current operations and keep each historical pack dated.

projects.title: Restore drill and dated milestones
projects.purpose: Exercise a full restore to a disposable OOTP save and retain dated postseason or season-end copies.
projects.next_action: Test a restore from the safety copy to a disposable OOTP save and log the result.

projects.title: Weekly and milestone preparation
projects.purpose: Package deterministic Monday and milestone outputs on compatible inputs for human review.
projects.next_action: Verify weekly and call-up outputs against two known checkpoints before adding automation.

projects.title: Postseason and tournament automation
projects.purpose: Test official qualification, DCS protection, clinch/elimination and postseason game coverage.
projects.next_action: Build postseason test fixtures from actual archive evidence before enabling automated claims.

projects.title: Publishing channel inventory
projects.purpose: Confirm destination, access, approval handoff and archive locations for each external channel.
projects.next_action: Verify the HTML site, StatsPlus, forum and video destinations with actual operator evidence.
